title: The Midnight Observatory Heist
summary: During a fierce thunderstorm, a priceless gem is stolen from the Hilltop Observatory. Players must investigate the scene, question suspects, and piece together clues to identify the thief.

scenes.title: Observatory Main Hall
scenes.description: The main hall of the observatory is dimly lit by emergency lights. The glass display case that held the Starfire Diamond is shattered. A thunderclap echoes outside.

scenes.title: Office of Dr. Vega
scenes.description: Dr. Vega's office is cluttered with star charts and books. A window is slightly open, letting in rain.

scenes.title: Library
scenes.description: The library has shelves of astronomy books. A map on the table shows escape routes.

scenes.title: Rooftop Telescope Deck
scenes.description: The rooftop deck is exposed to the storm. The telescope is covered with a tarp. A glint of something metallic catches your eye.

characters.name: Dr. Vega
characters.description: The head astronomer, a meticulous woman in her 50s. She seems nervous.

characters.name: Janitor Miller
characters.description: The janitor, a gruff man in his 60s. He was mopping near the hall.

characters.name: Professor Reed
characters.description: A visiting professor from a rival university, interested in the gem.

characters.name: Technician Kim
characters.description: A young technician who maintains the observatory equipment. He has a limp.

characters.name: Security Guard
characters.description: The night security guard, a burly man with a flashlight. He claims to have seen nothing.

items.name: Shattered Glass Case
items.description: The display case is broken, with glass shards scattered around.
items.inspectText: The glass is thick, but shattered cleanly. A small cloth fragment is caught on a shard.

items.name: Muddy Footprint
items.description: A clear footprint leading away from the case, size 10.
items.inspectText: The footprint is deep, suggesting a heavy person. It is made of reddish clay.

items.name: Wet Umbrella
items.description: A black umbrella, still wet, leaning against the desk.
items.inspectText: The umbrella is wet, but the floor around it is dry. It must have been brought inside recently.

items.name: Note
items.description: A handwritten note on Dr. Vega's desk.
items.inspectText: The note reads: 'Meet me at midnight. Bring the key.' It is signed with a 'V'.

items.name: Map with Marks
items.description: A map of the observatory with a route marked in red from the main hall to the roof.
items.inspectText: The red line goes through the library and ends at the rooftop. There is a small smudge of red clay near the roof exit.

items.name: Pair of Gloves
items.description: A pair of leather gloves, found under a chair.
items.inspectText: The gloves are worn, but the right glove has a small tear on the index finger. There is a faint smell of metal polish.

items.name: Crowbar
items.description: A crowbar hidden behind a vent on the roof.
items.inspectText: The crowbar is clean, but the tip matches the pry marks on the display case. A hair is caught in the hinge.

items.name: Gem Fragment
items.description: A small fragment of the Starfire Diamond, caught in a crevice.
items.inspectText: The fragment is a deep blue. It must have broken off during the theft.

clues.title: Cloth Fragment
clues.content: A small piece of blue fabric, likely from a lab coat.

clues.title: Red Clay
clues.content: The footprint contains red clay, which is found only near the rooftop garden.

clues.title: Umbrella Dry Floor
clues.content: The umbrella is wet, but the floor is dry, indicating it was brought inside after the rain started, possibly by someone who went out during the storm.

clues.title: Midnight Meeting
clues.content: The note says 'Meet me at midnight. Bring the key.' The key likely opens the display case.

clues.title: Map Route
clues.content: The map shows a route from the main hall to the roof. The red clay smudge matches the footprint clay.

clues.title: Torn Glove
clues.content: The torn glove suggests the thief might have injured their finger. The metal polish smell indicates handling of metal objects.

clues.title: Crowbar Hair
clues.content: A hair caught on the crowbar. It is black and short, possibly from the security guard.

clues.title: Gem Fragment Match
clues.content: The fragment matches the missing gem. It was found on the roof, suggesting the thief went there.

dialogues.question: Dr. Vega, where were you when the theft occurred?
dialogues.answer: I was in my office reviewing star charts. I heard the alarm but thought it was thunder.

dialogues.question: Professor Reed, what brings you here?
dialogues.answer: I was invited to study the gem. I was in the library reading when the alarm went off.

dialogues.question: Did you see anyone suspicious?
dialogues.answer: I saw the janitor near the main hall around 11:45. He seemed to be in a hurry.

dialogues.question: Technician Kim, why were you in the library?
dialogues.answer: I was fixing a bookshelf. I noticed the map on the table but didn't touch it.

dialogues.question: Security Guard, did you hear anything?
dialogues.answer: I was making rounds. I heard a crash from the main hall but by the time I got there, the gem was gone.

dialogues.question: Why is your hair on the crowbar?
dialogues.answer: I... I must have leaned against it earlier. I didn't steal anything!

finalLogic.motive: The security guard needed money to pay off gambling debts.
finalLogic.method: He used a crowbar to break the case, wore gloves, and escaped through the roof. The red clay on his shoes matched the rooftop garden.
finalLogic.winEnding: You present the crowbar with the guard's hair and the gem fragment. The guard confesses, and the gem is recovered.
finalLogic.failEnding: You accuse the wrong person. The real thief escapes, and the gem is lost forever.
